methods.label: Identify the two perpendicular distances
methods.explanation: \(CD=BC-BD=5\). Since \(D\) lies on the bisector of \(\angle BAC\), \(DC\perp AC\), and \(DE\perp AB\), we have \(DE=DC=5\).
